meta.description: Inner map renderer configuration — sprite sheet paths, overlay mappings, building mappings, fallback data

hiResSheets._doc: Sheets repainted at more than 32px a cell, in the original layout: path -> the original's width in px (ui/sheetScale.js scales cell addresses by width / this). terrain_<season>.png sheets count as 512 without being listed.

modernSheets._doc: LPC detail sheets repainted in the painted (modern) style at 4x, in their original layout (scripts/terrain_modern/build_details.py, build_props.py; the trees, palms, shore plants and grassland rocks: build_trees.py): original path -> the original's width in px. Buildings and town props built from these paths load assets/modern/<path under assets/> instead (core/customSheets.js modernSheet); ui/sheetScale.js scales the 32px cell addresses by the width ratio.

overlayMap._note: Maps sub-terrain IDs to overlay categories for the object layer

buildingToLPC._note: Maps building type keys to LPC structure sheet keys

spritePathToLPC._note: Maps hex sprite path substrings to LPC sheet keys (for buildings placed as sprite paths by innerMap.js)

interiorArt._note: Procedural interiors (INTERIOR_LAYOUTS): floor variants by floor id, the wall face by wall material, the door, and one sprite per furniture type. A floor or wall with tw/th is a seamless texture of whole 32px tiles (assets/buildingKit/interior_shell.png, PixelLab paintings made tileable): each tile draws its own cell by position; a wall's face (tw x 32) is the back wall seen front-on. A piece may name its own look (furniture.art, e.g. sack_coal); flat pieces cast no shadow. A bed's pillow/cover: where the head lies and where its own covers start (a sleeper is drawn under the piece's own art from there down); a bed with blanket instead (a straw pallet) lays a plain blanket of that colour over the sleeper, never another bed's covers. straw_1x2: the poor's long straw pallet (a two-tile bed of straw, composed from the straw cell); one that can't join stays the round 1x1 heap, its sleeper lying across it. blanketTop: where its blanket starts (the shoulders). tub_wood: the poor's wooden bathing tubs (PixelLab). rim: where a bather is cut off (the front lip), sink: how far below it they sit (tiles; 0.42 when unsaid). Furniture: 48px PixelLab pieces in the look of the pew (assets/buildingKit/furniture48.png, sw/sh 48; the old 32px assets/buildingKit/furniture.png stays for town props)

_note_characters: LPC character presets — each defines compositing layers drawn bottom-to-top. Paths are relative to assets/lpc/Characters/. Walk.png and Idle.png are appended automatically.

npcAppearanceMap._note: Maps NPC type keys to arrays of valid character preset IDs. NPC picks one by seeded index.

childLooks._note: Children under `under` years are drawn with the LPC child sprites (assets/lpc/Characters/Children: body, head, pants or skirt, shirt, hair; barefoot) at `scale` by age, instead of a shrunken adult. Skin and hair colour come from a parent on the map (else the household's hash); clothes from the family's means (`wealthByRole` → `wardrobe`). Names are the folder names under Children/.
childLooks._note_eraWardrobe: Before the mature world (data/eras.json ids) children wear their era's cloth instead of `wardrobe`: by the family's means (common/comfortable/noble) or one list for all. The Dawn's are undyed earthy tunics and leggings; the early kingdoms add the plain dyes (madder, woad, weld); the high kingdoms everything but the bright modern colours.
